title: A Symmetric Counterexample to the Snashall--Solberg Conjecture
summary: It is shown that the trivial extension of the Xu--Snashall algebra is a symmetric counterexample to the Snashall--Solberg conjecture, which states that the Hochschild cohomology ring of a finite-dimensional algebra modulo nilpotence is a finitely generated algebra. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first known selfinjective counterexample.
